points.K3: 前室正压，挡住外面空气
points.K5: 正压把病原体留在里面
points.K11: 清洁更衣室：再过一道门
points.K13: 严格按规程，规程也要验证

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一块空白的蓝色房间指示牌旁，对镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a blank blue room directory sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天跟着路线，走进三级实验室。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白的准入通知，站在实验室双开门前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank access approval notice in front of a double door to the laboratory.
shots.narration: 小研刚通过准入，第一次进三级实验室。

shots.scene: 老周站在门边，拍拍小研的肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside the door and pats the female graduate student on the shoulder.
shots.narration: 老周说：每一道门，都有讲究。

shots.scene: 实验楼示意图，最里面的房间标着生物危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A building diagram with a biohazard warning sign on the innermost rooms. No people.
shots.narration: 三级实验室用来关住病原体，

shots.scene: 生物安全柜图标里放着试管，周围一圈防护墙
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon holding test tubes, surrounded by a ring of protective walls. No people.
shots.narration: 做高风险病原的实验。

shots.scene: 小研在门边看墙上的监测面板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a monitoring panel on the wall beside the door.
shots.narration: 进门第一件事，看压力面板。

shots.scene: 面板特写：绿灯亮，红灯灭，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the panel: the green light is on, the red light is off, the screen is blank. No people.
shots.narration: 绿灯正常，红灯报警就别进。

shots.section_title: 前室正压，挡住外面空气
shots.scene: 示意图：第一道门后的前室标加号，箭头向外推
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the vestibule behind the first door marked with a plus icon and arrows pushing outward. No people.
shots.narration: 第一道门后的前室是正压，
overlay: 前室正压，挡住外面空气

shots.section_title: 前室正压，挡住外面空气
shots.scene: 外面的空气箭头被挡在门外
shots.prompt_en: Outside air arrows are blocked at the door. No people.
shots.narration: 外面的空气进不来。

shots.section_title: 前室正压，挡住外面空气
shots.scene: 门上贴着禁止入内标志
shots.prompt_en: A door with a no entry sign and a blank notice. No people.
shots.narration: 门上写着：仅限授权人员。

shots.scene: 小研在读卡器上刷卡，绿灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps a card on a door card reader and a green light comes on.
shots.narration: 刷卡进门，进入第一区。

shots.scene: 透过观察窗，看见里面几间工作间
shots.prompt_en: Through a viewing window, several work rooms are visible inside.
shots.narration: 窗里是一间间样本处理间。

shots.section_title: 正压把病原体留在里面
shots.scene: 示意图：正压房间在中间，红点被挡在另一侧的房间里
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a positive pressure room in the middle keeps red dots inside the room on the far side. No people.
shots.narration: 这一间加压，
overlay: 正压把病原体留在里面

shots.section_title: 正压把病原体留在里面
shots.scene: 红点想往外走，被气流推回去
shots.prompt_en: Red dots try to move outward and are pushed back by airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 把病原体留在里面那一间。

shots.scene: 小研走到下一扇门前，看门边面板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reaches the next door and checks the panel beside it.
shots.narration: 下一间是负压区。

shots.scene: 面板上一个减号图标，箭头朝里
shots.prompt_en: A panel with a minus icon and arrows pointing inward. No people.
shots.narration: 面板显示大约负24帕。

shots.scene: 门边密码键盘，小研输入后门开了
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters a code on a keypad beside the door and the door opens.
shots.narration: 进去前，还要过第二道门禁。

shots.scene: 老周坐在控制室，面前几块空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits in a control room in front of several blank computer screens.
shots.narration: 负压区旁边是控制室。

shots.scene: 风扇、火焰、雪花三个图标连到一台电脑
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a fan, a flame and a snowflake, all connected to one computer. No people.
shots.narration: 风机、暖通、空调都在这儿管。

shots.scene: 控制室一角，一块分成四格的空白监控屏
shots.prompt_en: A corner of the control room with a monitor split into four blank camera views. No people.
shots.narration: 这块屏是监控画面，

shots.scene: 摄像头图标和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A security camera icon next to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 谁进谁出，安保都看得到。

shots.scene: 一台不锈钢双门高压灭菌器，周转箱放在门口
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel double-door autoclave with a plastic tote box beside its door. No people.
shots.narration: 这里是高压灭菌器。

shots.scene: 箱子从里侧门进去，从外侧门出来
shots.prompt_en: A box goes into the autoclave from the inner side and comes out from the outer side. No people.
shots.narration: 离开实验室的东西，先灭菌，

shots.scene: 灭菌后的袋子沿箭头送到焚烧炉图标
shots.prompt_en: A sealed autoclaved bag moves along an arrow to an incinerator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再送去焚烧，这是规程要求。

shots.scene: 一个带观察窗的不锈钢传递窗
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel pass-through box with a small viewing window. No people.
shots.narration: 这是传递窗。

shots.scene: 样本盒放进传递窗，里面伸出戴手套的手取走
shots.prompt_en: A sample box is placed into the pass-through box and a gloved hand takes it out from the other side.
shots.narration: 样本从这儿递给里面的人。

shots.section_title: 清洁更衣室：再过一道门
shots.scene: 小研来到清洁更衣室门前，门边又有面板和键盘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student arrives at a changing room door with another panel and keypad beside it.
shots.narration: 再往前是清洁更衣室。
overlay: 清洁更衣室：再过一道门

shots.section_title: 清洁更衣室：再过一道门
shots.scene: 三个面板排成一排，颜色一个比一个深
shots.prompt_en: Three panels in a row, each shaded darker than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 又一道门禁，压力再降一级。

shots.scene: 储物架上整齐放着头罩、防护服、手套盒
shots.prompt_en: Shelves neatly stocked with hoods, protective suits and boxes of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 这里备齐了防护装备，

shots.scene: 小研从架上取下一套防护服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a protective suit from the shelf.
shots.narration: 进去前在这儿穿，出来在这儿脱。

shots.section_title: 严格按规程，规程也要验证
shots.scene: 墙上贴着几张空白规程，小研抬头看
shots.prompt_en: Several blank procedure sheets are posted on the wall and the female graduate student looks up at them.
shots.narration: 墙上贴着全部操作规程。
overlay: 严格按规程，规程也要验证

shots.section_title: 严格按规程，规程也要验证
shots.scene: 小研对照规程，一步一步打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank checklist, ticking each step.
shots.narration: 一步都不能省。

shots.section_title: 严格按规程，规程也要验证
shots.scene: 王老师拿着秒表和空白记录表，观察小研演练
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator with a stopwatch and blank form watches the female graduate student practise.
shots.narration: 规程本身，也要测试管不管用。

shots.scene: 一张贴有生物危害标志的空白承诺书
shots.prompt_en: A blank commitment sheet with a biohazard warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 使用者都要签一份承诺：

shots.scene: 两个图标：规程本、两人互相提醒
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a procedure book and two people reminding each other. No people.
shots.narration: 自己守规程，也提醒别人守。

shots.scene: 警示三角和一个差点摔倒的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon next to an icon of a person who almost trips. No people.
shots.narration: 事故和未遂事件，都要报告。

shots.scene: 体温计图标和病历本图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and a medical record icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出现相关症状、新的病情也要报告。

shots.scene: 墙上一张流程图：一串方框用箭头连起来，框里只有图标
shots.prompt_en: A flow chart on the wall: a chain of boxes linked by arrows, each box holding only an icon. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴顺序也贴在墙上。

shots.scene: 小研摘下戒指和手表，放进储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes off her ring and watch and puts them in a locker.
shots.narration: 先摘首饰，换上工作服和鞋套。

shots.scene: 小研系上送风呼吸器腰带，接上电池听风机声
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fastens a powered air purifying respirator belt and connects the battery to check the fan.
shots.narration: 装好呼吸器电池，先试机。

shots.scene: 小研戴上头罩，穿上连体防护服，戴好手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on the hood, steps into a coverall and pulls on gloves.
shots.narration: 再戴头罩、穿防护服、戴手套。

shots.scene: 平面图：进门箭头和出门箭头各走一条路
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with the entry arrow and the exit arrow following two separate routes. No people.
shots.narration: 一条路进，另一条路出。

shots.scene: 最里面的门上有禁止入内标志，镜头停在门外
shots.prompt_en: The innermost door with a no entry sign; the view stops outside the door. No people.
shots.narration: 里面是限制区，外人不进。

shots.scene: 小研在出口一侧按顺序脱下防护装备
shots.prompt_en: On the exit side the female graduate student removes her protective gear step by step.
shots.narration: 出来时，在这里脱防护。

shots.scene: 不锈钢淋浴间，门开着，喷头在上方
shots.prompt_en: A stainless steel shower cubicle with its door open and a shower head above. No people.
shots.narration: 脱完防护，先去淋浴。

shots.scene: 小研穿着自己的便服走出更衣室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks out of the changing room in her own everyday clothes.
shots.narration: 洗完再换回自己的衣服。

shots.scene: 感应水龙头特写，手一伸水就流
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a sensor tap: water flows as soon as a hand comes near.
shots.narration: 水龙头是感应的，

shots.scene: 手去摸门把、墙面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand touching a door handle and a wall, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 能不碰的表面，就别碰。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白讲义，指着一张平面图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank handbook and points at a floor plan inside.
shots.narration: 设计理念，以后的课再细讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现压力面板和门禁图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a pressure panel icon and an access card icon.
shots.narration: 先看压力，一道道门逐级进。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器、传递窗、规程本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an autoclave, a pass-through box and a procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 物品灭菌出，样本传递窗，照规程做。

shots.scene: 淋浴、感应龙头、单向箭头、体温计四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a shower, a sensor tap, a one-way arrow and a thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 单向进出，淋浴离开，有事就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门外，换好便服的小研向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside the laboratory door with the female graduate student in everyday clothes, both waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 规矩一道道守，安全一步步走，再见！
